summary: Backend-only regression for social access codes (VIP 100% off) and two-tier A/B affiliate system. Created /app/backend/tests/test_social_codes_and_ab_affiliates.py with 23 tests; all pass. Verified admin auth guardrails (401 without Bearer, 200 with 'test-admin-token'), auto-seeded codes VIP100/PASTOR100/CONVIDADO100 (validate returns discount_pct=100, final_price=0, free=true), free redeem path grants 12-month access, logs redemption, atomically increments used_count, and is idempotent for the same email, per-code max_uses limit enforced with 400 'limite de usos', expired codes return valid:false reason:'expired'. Affiliate creation: A ok; B with parent A ok; B without parent -> 400; B with self as parent -> 400; B whose parent is another B -> 400. Click tracking: known increments counter; unknown returns ok:false. Commission math verified via injected approved mp_orders: ANAA (gen A) revenue 57 -> direct 50% (28.50) + override 30% on BRUB revenue 57 (17.10) = 45.60 total, override_commission=17.10; BRUB (gen B) 30% = 17.10; rules object {50,30,30} returned. Stripe checkout persists affiliate_code='ANAA' on payment_transactions. Mercado Pago config returns enabled:false; POST preference returns 503 (MP_ACCESS_TOKEN empty). No live MP checkout attempted.

minor.issue: Pydantic body validation is evaluated before auth check, so a syntactically-invalid unauthenticated body returns 422 instead of 401. Not a real security issue (auth is enforced), but worth noting for API consistency. Tests were updated to send valid bodies so 401 is exercised.

critical_code_review_comments: access_code_routes._grant_access: comment states expires ~12 months but implementation uses timedelta(days=365) — semantically 1 year (12 months). OK, but the earlier comment 'expires_at 12 months' is fine — no action.

affiliate_routes.list_affiliates aggregates revenue from both mp_orders (BRL reais) and payment_transactions (Stripe cents converted to reais). Correct today, but if a non-BRL Stripe currency is ever configured, the aggregation would mix currencies. Consider tagging currency per sale.

access_code_routes.redeem: partial-discount codes (pct<100) block redeem correctly, but there is no endpoint that applies a partial code to a paid checkout — expected per current scope, worth flagging for future.
Admin auth returns 422 (validation) before 401 when payload is invalid — cosmetic; consider a Depends(_require_admin) at route-level so auth runs before body parsing if uniformity is desired.

Existing VIP100 used_count is incremented by 1 for email novo.aluno@example.com (grant + redemption row also cleaned).
